typhoon.status: No significant typhoon threat to upcoming ports
typhoon.summary: In-fa (Typhoon 31) remains very strong over the Mariana Islands, far southeast of mainland Japan. Champi has already become an extratropical low. No Regent-confirmed routing or Tokyo port changes were verified.
details: Latest independently verified JMA advisory: October 30, 3:45 AM JST, describing the 3 AM position at 17.2°N, 149.5°E (Mariana Islands); west-northwest at 35 km/h.
Central pressure 940 hPa; sustained winds 45 m/s (162 km/h); maximum gusts 65 m/s (234 km/h).
Since the October 29 morning report, pressure fell about 5 hPa (945 to 940), while sustained wind stayed about 45 m/s. The storm moved west-northwest from roughly 15.8°N, 155.5°E.
Forecast track west-northwest near the Mariana Islands on October 30–31, then toward the Ogasawara area around November 1. Longer-range turn and exact track remain uncertain.

Today's Pacific sailing: low direct wind-field risk, but check the ship's marine updates for local swell. Tomorrow's Tokyo arrival, transfer and flight: low direct storm risk; no confirmed cruise changes. More substantial high-seas risk is confined closer to the storm and Ogasawara region.
